<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
reduce_sum(x, axes=None, keepdims=False) -> 'core.SymbolicTensor'
```

Part of [`evoxc.ops`](/api/evoxc/ops/)

Sum of elements over the given axes.

## Parameters

- `x` — `SymbolicTensor` or Python scalar.

- `axes` — `None` (all axes → scalar), int, or tuple of ints.

- `keepdims` — Keep reduced axes as extent-1 dims.

## Returns

- `'core.SymbolicTensor'` — `SymbolicTensor` with reduced shape; dtype = numpy `sum` result dtype (bool → int64, else preserved; see numpy).

## Raises

- `core.TraceError` — no active trace; concrete `Tensor` operand.

- `core.ShapeError` — axis out of range.
